requirement: core 1.0GB installed target; optional up to 5.0GB of app-managed data; combined nominal 6.0GB

tasks.name: Define measured core and optional footprint
tasks.acceptance: Document accounting categories; use actual on-device APIs to distinguish APK/core, mutable user data, extra packs and OS overhead; no false 1GB installed claim.
evidence: android/gradle/app/src/main/java/io/godseed/one/PackBridge.java: actual APK, app-private mutable/cache/optional bytes and usable filesystem space; OS overhead excluded
docs/STORAGE_IMPLEMENTATION.md: accounting scope; no claimed on-device measurements

tasks.name: Design safe offline optional pack manifest and storage host
tasks.acceptance: Pack IDs, hashes, schema, compatibility, app-private installation plus user-chosen local SAF import; core playable offline without optional packs; no generic storage permission.
evidence: android/gradle/app/src/main/java/io/godseed/one/PackManifest.java: bounded lore schema, SHA256, dependencies and compatibility
android/gradle/app/src/main/java/io/godseed/one/PackBridge.java: SAF selection and explicit native consent; core remains independent

tasks.name: Implement explicit quota and low-space guards
tasks.acceptance: Optional <=5e9 bytes, managed total <=6e9 bytes, free-after-write >= max(500MB, 10% currently free); account for temporary peak and failure rollback; never auto reserve full 5GB.
evidence: android/gradle/app/src/main/java/io/godseed/one/PackStore.java: staged hash verification, free-space recheck, recovery and isolated removal
tests/java/StorageChecks.java: filesystem and quota checks including mid-write free-space drop

tasks.name: Add user-facing storage manager with safe remove/export
tasks.acceptance: Display actual core/optional/free values, user confirmation for installing/removing packs, prevent deletion of saves, transactional update and backup safety.
evidence: src/storage.js: measured accounting, explicit import/removal requests and discovery-gated lore
tests/storage_ui.py: fake-host contract; no automatic actions, numeric units, hidden lore
tests/lifecycle_acceptance.py: existing JSON save export/restore and quota-failure preservation

tasks.name: Automated boundary tests and Android storage QA
tasks.acceptance: Offline core/optional=0, GB/GiB conversions, corrupt/oversized pack, exact quotas, disk-full mid-write, migration and real device measurements or explicit hardware blocker. Check with 2GB and 3GB TOTAL-RAM Android devices, and prove optional disk packs are lazy-loaded without proportionate process RAM growth; report separate RSS/PSS and storage bytes, or mark device QA blocked.
evidence: tests/java/StorageHostTest.java: manifest/hash/dependency and filesystem unit tests
tests/storage_host.py: JVM filesystem boundary tests; not an Android execution test
tests/test_gradle_package.py: compiled host and no-permission signed APK verification
BLOCKED: no attached physical 2GB/3GB Android devices; SAF/lifecycle/upgrade, RSS/PSS/FPS and installed OS footprint NOT VERIFIED
